evidence.boundary-evaluation: docs/research/guest-startup.md SHA-256 d949de86d92b37a986f7667275692920763569959feb2dc8aea828139121b21a correlates observed main-thread JNI startup frames with stock Dev_PCIeInit's failed-open retry and the absent /dev/xdma0_bypass interface. Its success branch requires a 16 MiB shared device mapping. This establishes a real instrument control-plane dependency, while useful UI, acquisition, exact syscall errno, retry exhaustion and subsequent initialization remain unestablished. A file or successful return substitution would not supply faithful register behavior. The prior static hardware boundary is confirmed, not materially redesigned; no architecture reconciliation is required. Readme and research overviews link this newer runtime evidence.
